trigger.what: Scout ran the weekly 46-query battery across all four surfaces and logged every citation and recommendation.
Hero SKU citation count fell to 11 against competitor A’s 29 — a nine-point share drop in three weeks.
Steward traced four wrong-spec answers to a single stale attribute on the Walmart feed and pinned the card for a decision.

policy.label: GTIN coverage

policy.label: Required attribute completeness
policy.note: category-required fields populated from the PIM

policy.label: Schema coverage on PDPs
policy.note: Product, Offer, rating and policy types present

policy.label: Feed freshness
policy.note: time from PIM change to feed pickup

policy.label: Price + availability accuracy
policy.note: what the agent reads vs what the site charges

policy.label: Factual density per PDP
policy.note: machine-readable spec attributes per product page

constraints.label: Canonical product facts, single source
constraints.detail: The PIM is the only source of truth. No channel-level attribute overrides — a fix goes in once and regenerates everywhere.

constraints.label: Machine-readable policy requirement
constraints.detail: Returns, shipping and warranty publish as structured data. Human-readable copy is generated from the same record, never written separately.

constraints.label: No synthetic specifications
constraints.detail: Nothing enters the catalogue that was inferred, scraped from a competitor or generated. Missing means missing.

constraints.label: Price parity with the storefront
constraints.detail: The feed price is the site price at read time. A stale price is pulled rather than published.
